newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's real dips 0.01 pct in calm trading.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's real dips 0.01 pct in calm trading.

text.p: Brazil's real dipped 0.01 percent to close at 1.0671 per dollar in calm trading on the commercial foreign exchange market, dealers said.
In late afternoon, the Central Bank bought dollars at 1.0670 reais each to drain excess dollars from the market, they added.
At 1645 local/1945 GMT, preliminary Friday figures for commercial and financial forex contracts showed a $20 million surplus. Thursday, forex contracts posted a $124.5 million surplus.
In the interbank floating rate market, the real closed at 1.0717, down 0.01 percent.
In the parallel market, the real closed flat at 1.130.
